page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines. From top to bottom: the title block (EXAMEN, LIBRI QVEM D. TILEMANNUS HESHUSIUS ... DE PRÆSENTIA CORPORIS CHRISTI IN CŒNA DOMINI), the author line (Autore P. BOQVINO Theologo.), the address "LECTORI." with a short Latin paragraph containing a Greek phrase, the verse address "AD D. TIL. HESHUSIUM." with a two-line verse, and the imprint "BASILEAE, PER IOANNEM OPORINUM." Handwritten ownership note at the top, not printed.
page.l: Quæ in controuersia de Cœna Dom. ho-
sa & pulchrè expedita hic comperies. Tan-
tum vide, ne temerè ante improbes,

l.i: Sperne repugnando tibi tu contrarius esse:
Conveniet nulli, qui secum diffidet ipse.

page.notes: The handwritten ownership note at the top ("Collegij Societatis Jesu Monacensis") is not printed and is left out. The Greek phrase in the LECTORI paragraph is doubtful: the letters on the scan are not clear enough to read with confidence, so the likely words ἄνω καὶ κάτω are given with [?] on each word. The Greek is not reproduced exactly as printed. Spelling changes made: initial and medial consonantal u written v (vide, voluuntur, Conveniet).
